follow-up time: 6 months, with an additional 3-month follow-up for the experimental group
outcome: Quality of life of the parents
cohort: Sixty children diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder (ASD).
finding: The study found that a 6-month intervention of PECS and PII significantly improved social relationship and reciprocity, speech language communication, and quality of life of parents in children with ASD compared to routine care.
